# LiveDomJS — Full AI Reference

> This is the extended version of llms.txt. For a quick summary, see llms.txt.

**Package:** `gadingrengga/livedomjs`  
**GitHub:** https://github.com/GadingRengga/LiveDomJs  
**Docs:** https://gadingrengga.github.io/LiveDomJs  
**Author:** Gading Rengga

---

## Mental Model

LiveDomJS turns Laravel controllers into reactive UI endpoints using only HTML attributes.

```
[HTML Element with live-scope + live-click]
        ↓  (user interaction)
[livedom.js serializes inputs within scope]
        ↓
POST /ajax/{Controller}/{action}
        ↓
[AjaxController dispatches to App\Http\Controllers\{Controller}@{action}]
        ↓
[Controller returns JSON {success, message, data} or a View]
        ↓
[livedom.js injects response into live-target element]
```

No routes to write. No JS to write. No component classes to create.

---

## Complete Attribute Reference

### live-scope
Defines the request boundary. Only inputs inside this element are sent.
Maps directly to a Laravel controller class.

```html
<div live-scope="UserController">              <!-- App\Http\Controllers\UserController -->
<div live-scope="Admin/UserController">        <!-- App\Http\Controllers\Admin\UserController -->
<div live-scope="Invoice.ItemController">      <!-- App\Http\Controllers\Invoice\ItemController -->
```

### live-click / live-change / live-input / live-keyup / live-submit / live-hover
Binds a DOM event to a controller action.

```html
<button live-click="store">Save</button>
<select live-change="filterByCategory">...</select>
<input live-input="search" />           <!-- debounced -->
<input live-keyup="suggest" />
<form live-submit="processOrder">...</form>
<div live-hover="loadPreview">Hover me</div>
```

### live-target
CSS selector for where the response HTML is injected.

```html
<button live-click="load" live-target="#result">Load</button>
<div id="result"></div>
```

### live-poll
Automatically triggers an action on an interval (milliseconds).

```html
<div live-poll="5000" live-click="refresh" live-target="#feed" live-scope="FeedController" id="feed-panel">
  Auto-refreshes every 5 seconds
</div>
```

**SPA cleanup:** Intervals are automatically cleared when the element leaves the DOM during SPA navigation (`live-dom:afterSpa`). No manual cleanup needed.

**Note:** `live-poll` requires the element to have an `id` attribute — the target defaults to `#id` of the element.

### live-compute
Client-side reactive expression. Re-evaluates whenever any named input in the scope changes.

```html
<input name="qty" value="5" />
<input name="price" value="30000" />
<input name="discount" value="10" />

<!-- Updates instantly as user types — no server call -->
<input live-compute="qty * price * (1 - discount / 100)"
       live-compute-format="idr"
       readonly />
```

Supported aggregate functions:
```html
<input live-compute="sum(subtotal)" />          <!-- all inputs named "subtotal" -->
<input live-compute="sum(subtotal_?)" />        <!-- subtotal_1, subtotal_2, ... -->
<input live-compute="avg(score)" />
<input live-compute="min(price)" />
<input live-compute="max(price)" />
<input live-compute="count(item)" />
<input live-compute="sumif(category_?, 'A', amount_?)" />  <!-- sum amount_? where category_? == 'A' -->
```

Built-in format registry:

| Key       | Output example  | Notes                              |
|-----------|-----------------|------------------------------------|
| `idr`     | `1.000.000`     | Indonesian Rupiah                  |
| `usd`     | `1,000,000.00`  | US Dollar                          |
| `jpy`     | `1,000,000`     | Japanese Yen (no decimals)         |
| `eur`     | `1.000.000,00`  | Euro                               |
| `percent` | `12.5%`         | Percentage                         |
| `plain`   | `1,000,000`     | Plain number, en-US grouping       |
| `auto`    | —               | Follows `LiveDom.setCurrency()`    |

Advanced options:
```html
<!-- Skip initial calculation; compute only after user first types -->
<input live-compute="qty * price" live-compute-init="false" readonly />

<!-- Only recalculate when specific inputs change (1500ms window) -->
<input live-compute="dpp * tax_rate" live-compute-trigger="dpp,tax_rate" readonly />

<!-- Skip computation when this element is focused (prevents fighting user input) -->
<input live-compute="qty * price" live-compute-skip="true" />

<!-- Max decimal places -->
<input live-compute="total / qty" live-decimal-max="4" readonly />

<!-- Auto-follow global currency — reacts to LiveDom.setCurrency() -->
<input live-compute="subtotal * 1.11" live-compute-format="auto" readonly />
```

Custom format registration:
```js
window.LiveDom.registerFormat('myr', {
    kind: 'currency', locale: 'ms-MY',
    thousandSep: ',', decimalSep: '.', defaultDecimals: 2
});
window.LiveDom.setCurrency('myr');  // all live-compute-format="auto" elements react
```

### live-show / live-class / live-style / live-attr
Reactive DOM directives driven by input values in the same scope.

```html
<div live-show="qty > 0">Only visible when qty > 0</div>

<span live-class="total > 1000000 ? 'text-green-500' : 'text-red-500'">
  Dynamic class
</span>

<div live-style="opacity: active ? 1 : 0.4; font-weight: vip ? 'bold' : 'normal'">
  Dynamic style
</div>

<!-- live-attr: comma-separated attr:expression pairs.
     Parser is depth-aware — commas inside (), [], {}, or strings are safe.
     Colons inside expressions (ternary, URLs) are also handled correctly. -->
<button live-attr="disabled:qty<1, title:qty<1?'Out of stock':'Add to cart'">
  Add to cart
</button>

<!-- false/null removes the attribute; true sets it to its own name (boolean attrs) -->
<input live-attr="required:is_required, readonly:is_locked, disabled:is_locked">
```

### live-bind
Two-way data binding between inputs.

```html
<input name="username" live-bind="username" />
<span live-bind="username">Will mirror the input value</span>
```

### live-realtime
Broadcasts the action via Laravel Reverb to all users who have the same `live-scope` open.

```html
<button live-click="refresh"
        live-realtime="true"
        live-target="#panel">
  Sync All Users
</button>
```

### live-spa-region
Converts a region to Single Page App. All links/forms inside are intercepted.

```html
<main live-spa-region="main">
  <!-- Navigation handled by pushState -->
  <!-- Browser back/forward work correctly -->
  <!-- Inline scripts re-execute on each navigation -->
</main>
```

---

## Controller Examples

### Basic AJAX
```php
// No new routes, no traits, no base class needed
public function checkAvailability(Request $request): \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
{
    $exists = User::where('username', $request->username)->exists();

    return response()->json([
        'success' => true,
        'data'    => $exists
            ? '<span class="text-red-500">Username taken</span>'
            : '<span class="text-green-500">Available</span>',
    ]);
}
```

### Returning a View
```php
public function loadTable(Request $request)
{
    $items = Item::where('category', $request->category)->get();
    return view('partials.items-table', compact('items'));
    // AjaxController auto-renders and wraps in JSON
}
```

### View with Error or Success Message
AjaxController inspects view data for `error` and `success` keys:
```php
// success:false + message from view data
return view('partials.result', ['error' => 'Record not found']);

// success:true + custom message from view data
return view('partials.result', compact('items') + ['success' => 'Items loaded']);
```

### Validation Error Pattern
```php
public function store(Request $request)
{
    $validated = $request->validate([
        'name'  => 'required|string|max:255',
        'price' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
    ]);

    $item = Item::create($validated);

    return response()->json([
        'success' => true,
        'message' => 'Item saved',
        'data'    => view('partials.item-row', compact('item'))->render(),
    ]);
}
```

---

## Real-Time Setup

### Requirements
- Laravel Reverb installed and configured
- Queue worker running (`php artisan queue:work`)
- `REVERB_APP_KEY`, `REVERB_APP_SECRET`, `REVERB_APP_ID` in `.env`
- On Laravel 11/12: `php artisan install:broadcasting` first

### Auto-Detection
`InjectLiveDomAssets` middleware checks `config('broadcasting.connections.reverb.key')`.
If set → auto-injects CSRF meta, `window.userGlobal`, Pusher-JS, Laravel Echo, and `dynamic-broadcast.js`.
If not set → silently skips (no JS errors, no "Echo is not defined").

### Manual Broadcast from PHP
```php
reverbDynamic(
    controller:  'Dashboard/MetricsController',
    function:    'getMetrics',
    target:      '#dashboard-panel',
    data:        [],
    typeChannel: 'public',
    recipients:  ['realtime-updates']
);
```

Channel name construction:
- `'public'` + recipient `'realtime-updates'` → channel `public-realtime-updates`
- `'private'` + recipient `5` (user ID)       → channel `private-user.5`
- `'presence'` + recipient `'room.1'`         → channel `presence-room.1`

---

## Installation & Config

### Minimal Setup
```bash
composer require gadingrengga/livedomjs
# Done. Works immediately.
```

### Optional Publish
```bash
php artisan livedomjs:install --publish
# Publishes config/livedomjs.php and public/vendor/livedomjs/
```

### Config Reference
```php
// config/livedomjs.php
return [
    'route_prefix'         => 'ajax',      // /ajax/{controller}/{action}
    'route_middleware'     => ['web'],      // applied to AJAX route
    'auto_inject'          => true,         // auto-inject livedom.js
    'auto_inject_realtime' => true,         // auto-inject Echo/Reverb if configured
    'jquery_cdn'           => null,         // null = not injected (livedom.js doesn't need it)
    'pusher_cdn'           => 'https://js.pusher.com/8.4.0/pusher.min.js',
    'echo_cdn'             => 'https://unpkg.com/laravel-echo@1.16.1/dist/echo.iife.js',
    'serve_assets'         => true,         // serve JS from package without vendor:publish
];
```

---

## Package Structure
```
LiveDomJs/
├── config/livedomjs.php
├── resources/
│   ├── js/
│   │   ├── livedom.js                          # Core engine, vanilla JS
│   │   └── dynamic-broadcast.js                # Realtime Echo listener
│   └── views/components/
│       └── livedom-scripts.blade.php           # <x-livedomjs::livedom-scripts />
└── src/
    ├── Console/InstallCommand.php              # artisan livedomjs:install
    ├── Events/DynamicBroadcastEvent.php        # Reverb broadcast event
    ├── Helpers/BroadcastHelper.php             # reverbDynamic() global helper
    ├── Http/
    │   ├── Controllers/AjaxController.php      # Dynamic dispatcher
    │   └── Middleware/InjectLiveDomAssets.php  # Auto-inject assets
    └── Providers/LiveDomServiceProvider.php    # Registers everything
```

---

## Comparison with Similar Tools

| Feature                      | LiveDomJS      | Livewire        | HTMX           |
|------------------------------|----------------|-----------------|----------------|
| New PHP files per feature    | **0**          | 1 component     | 0              |
| New routes per feature       | **0**          | 0               | Yes            |
| Client-side calculations     | **Built-in**   | Server only     | Manual JS      |
| Real-time WebSocket          | **1 attribute**| Complex setup   | Extension      |
| Build step required          | **No**         | No              | No             |
| jQuery dependency            | **No**         | No              | No             |
| Works with existing routes   | **Yes**        | Yes             | Yes            |

**Best use case:** Data-heavy Laravel applications (ERP, CRM, admin panels, invoicing) where you want reactive UIs without the overhead of a JS framework or Livewire's component model.
